The project docs show the two pieces, but not a complete global setup that guarantees OpenAI is never contacted.

**Ollama LLM:** The docs show the Ollama integration package and how to instantiate it. "`llama-index-llms-ollama`: Ollama (llama3, mistral, qwen, etc.)." [llama_index/docs/src/content/docs/framework/module_guides/models/llms/local.md]

"from llama_index.llms.ollama import Ollama" [llama_index/docs/src/content/docs/framework/understanding/using_llms.md]

The example there is `Ollama(model="llama3.3", request_timeout=60.0, context_window=8000)`, and it assumes Ollama is installed and running.

**Hugging Face embeddings:** The docs name `HuggingFaceEmbedding` as the local embedding option, which "runs any [Sentence Transformers] model locally" [llama_index/docs/src/content/docs/framework/module_guides/models/llms/local.md]. The excerpts don't include its import path or the package name to install, so check the embeddings module guide for those.

**Global setting:** The docs show that embedding models are set globally through `Settings`: "# changing the global default" followed by "Settings.embed_model = OpenAIEmbedding()" [llama_index/docs/src/content/docs/framework/module_guides/models/embeddings.md]. The same pattern applies to the LLM with `Settings.llm`, though the excerpts don't show that line explicitly.

Putting this together (the `HuggingFaceEmbedding` import and arguments are from general LlamaIndex usage, not the excerpts):

```python
from llama_index.core import Settings
from llama_index.llms.ollama import Ollama
from llama_index.embeddings.huggingface import HuggingFaceEmbedding

Settings.llm = Ollama(model="llama3.3", request_timeout=60.0, context_window=8000)
Settings.embed_model = HuggingFaceEmbedding(model_name="BAAI/bge-small-en-v1.5")
```

Pull the Ollama model first, and make sure the same `Settings` assignments run before you build any index or query engine.

**Confirming OpenAI is never contacted:** The excerpts don't say explicitly that setting these two `Settings` fields is enough to rule out every OpenAI call. From general knowledge, the defaults for `Settings.llm` and `Settings.embed_model` are OpenAI, so overriding both should cover the usual paths. To verify, run without `OPENAI_API_KEY` set, or block outbound traffic to api.openai.com. The privacy guide's fully-local stack also uses a local vector store, which "[...] the default in-memory `SimpleVectorStore`" covers [llama_index/docs/src/content/docs/framework/understanding/privacy.md].
